notes.title: Second Summer Patch! (July 20th)
notes.content:
Heeeeeello gamers!

Here's a new patch for y'all, with some nice additions and some experimental things!
[list]
[*] [b]Final boss weaknesses tweaked:[/b] The Chaos Lord can now take more Normal and Electric damage.
[*] [b]Final Boss spawns:[/b] The Chaos Lord can now spawn chaos enemies every 30 seconds to aid him in battle! (To avoid overwhelming the players, the enemies die 20 seconds after spawning)
[*] [b]Player's clothes:[/b] The player's scarf and pants's colors now change depending on the bomb that's currently chosen! How neat!
[*] [b]Post-processing:[/b] New post-processing effects have been added to make the game look nicer!
[*] [b]Chaos AbsOrbs:[/b] Absolute menaces. Insane beasts. The chaos AbsOrbs now appear in Chaos Realized instead of normal AbsOrbs. On the one hand, these enemies cannot actually absorb bombs, but on the other hand, [i][b]they are completely immune to damage.[/b][/i] Your best bet is to avoid them. (Or, if you like danger, exploit their immunity to level up your bombs)
[/list]

That's that for today's patch, hope you enjoy the new and improved Device of Bakudan!

notes.title: Small Summer Patch!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Hope you've been enjoying Device of Bakudan and your summer holidays! (If you have those, hahaha)
This patch includes some changes and some new additions to the game:
[list]
[*] [b]Bomb balancing:[/b] Bomb stats, experience gain and other traits have been balanced, to make the game more enjoyable and easier for those playing in harder difficulties!
[*] [b]Extra level isn't saved:[/b] If players left the main game and played the Extra level, it would be saved for players to replay by pressing Continue, preventing players from continuing their main playthrough of the game. This has now been fixed.
[*] [b]CRITICAL HITS![/b] Bombs now have a small chance to deal critical hits to enemies, and each bomb and summon (Steam cloud, Electric Star, etc) has different critical hit chances and damage multiplication stats!
[/list]

That's all for this patch! Thank you for playing Device of Bakudan!

notes.title: Save System + Music Room added!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today's patch is simple but adds something many people wanted - a [b]save system![/b]
[list]
[*] When starting a new level or entering the previous level's portal, the new level is saved and can be played directly in the main menu!
[*] Difficulty settings cannot be changed in the middle of a playthrough, though; to change difficulty, start a new game
[/list]

I've also implemented a Music Room, so players can listen to the game's OST!

That's all for today, thank you for playing [b]Device of Bakudan[/b] and I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: New Patch! (June 13th)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today's patch brings some new additions to Device of Bakudan along with some fixes:


[b]7 new achievements! Wow![/b]

[b]Ice Worm changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] HP decreased
[*] Damage and ice effect duration increased
[/list]

[b]Chaos Lord changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage increased
[*] Now the Chaos Lord can take damage from Electric Clouds (Ice+Electric) and Water Explosions (Ice+Fire)
[*] HP decreased in phases 1 and 2, and increased in phase 3
[*] Shield HP doubled
[/list]

[b]Bomb changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Water Explosion's AoE and damage increased, and the damage scales properly with the Ice Bomb's level
[*] Electric Cloud's outline has been fixed to show the real size of the cloud
[*] Health Bombs now deal a LOT of damage in early game
[/list]

[b]New difficulty setting![/b]
[list]
[*] This difficulty setting modifies enemy HP, damage and how long they wait between attacks
[*] Ranges from 1 (Normal) to 2 (Hard)
[*] Killing a boss increases the game difficulty by 0.1
[/list]

[b]Other fixes (SFX, VFX, balancing)[/b]

[i]To be added:[/i]
[list]
[*] Save system
[*] Chaos Lord frequent beam attack
[*] SFX additions + fixes
[*] VFX fixes
[*] More balancing fixes
[*] Visual feedback when a bomb becomes amplified
[/list]

[i]See you next patch! Thank you for playing [b]Device of Bakudan[/b] and I hope everyone enjoys these new changes![/i]

notes.title: Second achievement patch!
notes.content:
One of the hidden achievements was impossible to unlock, but now...

You can access a [b][i]secret[/i][/b] level by typing "bakudan" while on the main menu!

notes.title: Release Day Patch 1 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
Some bugs have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Players cannot open the pause menu while loading a level anymore
[*] Eye rocks in level 3 don't appear outside the level layout
[*] Bomb explosion sound volume increased in every level, not just in level 1
[/list]
